Master.note: The player the Butler chose as master; dead players are allowed.

setupPrep.none: its tokens mark what a player chooses at night, placed when they choose

reminderMovement.why: Placed on a new choice each night.

full.text: The Butler chooses a player: mark them *MASTER*.
full.reason: Says the Master token goes on the chosen player.

full.text: The Butler chooses a player: move *MASTER* to them.
full.reason: Says the Master token moves to tonight’s choice.
